meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

howto.what: 当你使用hyperframes add或hyperframes catalog命令时，Claude能帮你安装注册表中的块或组件，并输出接线指引。它还能配置安装路径、接线块到主场景，以及指导创建新块或组件用于贡献。
howto.when: 当你提到"hyperframes add"或"hyperframes catalog"，或者要求安装、查找、接线注册表项目时触发。

howto.what_en: When you run hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, Claude installs registry blocks/components and prints wiring snippets. It also configures paths, wires blocks into the host scene, and guides you through authoring new items for upstream contribution.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "hyperframes add" or "hyperframes catalog", or ask to install, search, or wire a registry item.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block into my current project.
say_en.note: Installs the block and shows the wiring snippet.
Runs catalog filtered by social tag.

say_en.text: How do I wire the grain-overlay component into my scene?
say_en.note: Provides wiring steps and attribute details.
